title: The lesson is the same. The learner isn't.
description: Lumi — Every mind learns its own way. An AI learning companion in Arabic and English. For children who need a different way into learning.

title: Reading should not block learning.
description: 11% pooled dyslexia prevalence among Arab primary-school children aged 6–13. 18 studies. 30,243 participants. Estimates vary across countries. Children need accessible explanations; adults need visibility into learning. Source: Aldakhil et al., 2024, systematic review and meta-analysis.

title: One companion. Three ways to learn.
description: Dyslexia: voice-first support and spoken answers. Learning difficulties: smaller steps and understanding checks. Autism: calm, predictable interactions. Adults choose the mode and language, then review learning observations. Educational support — not diagnosis or a replacement for specialists.

title: See Lumi in action.
description: 60-second product demo. Child experience → adapted support → adult insights. Video to be supplied by the Lumi team.

title: Start in Jordan. Expand with evidence.
description: 4.56M primary pupils across Jordan and Saudi Arabia in 2024. $30.1M illustrative annual opportunity: 4.56M × 11% × $60/year. Jordan-only scenario: $7.4M/year, before access and purchasing constraints. Initial target: 10 partners × 30 paid learners = $18K annual recurring revenue. Scenarios, not forecasts. Primary enrollment is an age proxy; regional prevalence is not a country-specific estimate. Sources: World Bank / UNESCO UIS, 2024 enrollment; Aldakhil et al., 2024. Price and adoption are assumptions.

title: A focused position in an active market.
description: Lexsee: guided reading, fluency support and teacher insights. Faheem: live one-to-one tutoring and parent reports. Khanmigo: broad AI tutoring with family oversight. Lumi: Arabic/English support, three adult-selected learning modes, one shared learning record. Compete on fit and usability; learning outcomes still need validation. Sources: official competitor websites, accessed October 2026.

title: Schools first. Families alongside.
description: Schools and centers: proposed $5 per student/month, billed annually. Families: proposed $10 per child/month. School-led pilots → paid renewals → parent referrals. Validate willingness to pay, retention and AI/voice cost per active learner.

title: Early interest. A measurable route to adoption.
description: 37 waitlist signups in the first three hackathon hours. 10,000 Instagram views in 24 hours. Feedback from 2 specialists and 3 teachers; 1 Amman school willing to trial. @lumi.mena → parent/teacher demos → supervised pilots → paid conversion. Track activation, weekly use, teacher-rated usefulness and renewal. Founder-reported signals — not paid traction or proven learning impact.

title: Help us turn interest into evidence.
description: Seeking pilot schools, special-education partners and parent communities. Next milestone: a supervised pilot measuring usability, repeat use and learning support. Hala Shbeita · Yousef Smreen · Saif Shbeita instagram.com/lumi.mena Lumi — Every mind learns its own way.
